text: MIDDLE → NEWEST, aligned on the sanctum wall (parts 2 and 4). Regular changes: wide → moon, seed → horn, arrow stays; wave → lean-mid; and CROOK → LEAN-LOW: (tree seed)(crook seed) becomes (tree horn)(lean-low horn), (crook seed)(seed+arch wide) becomes (lean-low horn)(seed+arch moon). So crook wasn't abolished, it was redrawn as the low leaning sign.
